entries.title: Merlin the duck steals the spotlight at President Sheinbaum's news briefing

entries.title: China hits back at U.S. sanctions on tech giants, restricting its exports to American defense firms

entries.title: Wanted: Jobs, critical minerals as Zambia's election nears

entries.title: Schweinsteiger's Ivory Coast comments spark racism debate

entries.title: Europe on red alert for record-breaking heat

entries.title: Turkey arrests more than 200 in crackdown before NATO summit
entries.snippet: The Ankara prosecutor's office said 209 people were detained, while 32 others remained at large. Turkey has announced a ban on demonstrations amid preparations for next month's NATO summit in the capital.

entries.title: Europe's defense ambitions get reality check
entries.snippet: European countries have been trying to scale up and integrate their military capabilities, but their current defense production and procurement model is not fit for purpose, say experts.

entries.title: EU hosts Taliban for migrant return talks in Brussels
entries.snippet: The EU is hosting Taliban officials after Belgium granted temporary visas for talks on returning failed Afghan asylum-seekers. The meeting is one of the bloc's highest-level contacts with the Taliban since 2021.

entries.title: Germany news: Merz hails pension reform proposals
entries.snippet: Chancellor Merz says a proposed pension reform package should be fully implemented. A survey has shown that almost half of teachers in Germany find pupils' behavior stressful. DW has more.

entries.title: More than a unibrow: The enduring appeal of Frida Kahlo
entries.snippet: She shunned feminine beauty ideals, was bisexual and a political radical, all while being brutally honest in her art. A major Frida Kahlo exhibition opens at London's Tate Modern.

entries.title: Germany's pension plans draw praise and outrage
entries.snippet: A 33-point plan to reform Germany's pension system has drawn praise and criticism in almost equal measure. Centrist politicians have called it a good compromise, but opposition parties on the left and right are unhappy.

entries.title: Israel, Lebanon to hold new round of US-hosted talks

entries.title: US: Trump threatens prison for Reflecting Pool 'vandalism'

entries.title: US: Trump signs new executive orders to boost quantum computing

entries.title: World Cup: Amiri another wildcard for Nagelsmann's Germany

entries.title: Meet Andy Burnham, Britain's likely next prime minister

entries.title: Fact check: AI fakes around the World Cup spread political narratives
entries.snippet: Keir Starmer in a Croatia jersey. An Iranian protest against a US strike. Calls to arrest Brazil's President Lula. Adolf Hitler in the German fan section — all supposedly seen at the World Cup. But none of it is real.

entries.title: Germany and UK rebuilding ties 10 years after Brexit vote
entries.snippet: Ten years after the referendum, the two countries are strengthening their ties once again. The stability of these ties is now being put to the test with Keir Starmer to be replaced as prime minister.

entries.title: Iran-US talks to end war beset by tension, mistrust
